budget.cap_rule: retain completed results and explicit incomplete status; no smaller substitute budgets or replacement seeds

calendar.warmup: daily prices only, no extra monthly training origins

decision: Diagnose current readout before further feature searches; no market indicator promotion or benchmark tuning in this task.
engineering_seeds: separate root 93117, tiny fixtures only; no audit seeds until registration and implementation freeze
failure_policy: Implementation bugs may be repaired with failing regression evidence and unchanged scientific design. Any scores seen before repair remain retained and labeled invalid; no tuning on them.

features.constant: zero on every query; exact no-added-split identity
features.noisy: forthcoming-month state plus independent N(0,1) measurement noise, independent across releases
features.nuisance: independent stationary AR(1), phi=.8, variance1, forthcoming-month value

law.first_price: log price zero on 2012-01-01; increments on later daily dates
law.interpretation: beta=.15 intentionally large persistent drift stress; not fitted Bitcoin law or market realism claim
law.release: state for forthcoming month exists and scalar is released at previous month end after close, before forecast

limits: descriptive sensitivity under two laws, not error-control/power certification
not a test of trading profitability, transaction costs or prospective Bitcoin skill
not a rescue or repeat of nineteen failed variants
finite path ensembles have Monte Carlo error; exact terminal oracle is the primary available-information diagnostic
current-signal oracle is deliberately restricted; no full-information claim for noisy signal
64 histories may leave wide uncertainty; no result-dependent expansion
missing: No exogenous missing dates in law; preserve all decoder missing-context, insufficient-history and empty-cell behavior. Missing-feature encoding not generalized beyond this experiment.

oracle.downside_scope: issued finite empirical forecasts, not exact ideal-law oracle; retain each bank and discrepancy; no fair correction of fixed decoder forecasts
oracle.information: full observed price history plus current scalar only; historical scalar archive excluded
oracle.no_realized_future: oracle simulator starts from posterior and independent futures; never uses realized future states or price suffix
oracle.noisy: assimilate current scalar with measurement variance1
oracle.path_losses: two independent conditional future-path banks of 128 draws per information set/query; reuse all three path outcomes from each draw
oracle.price_only: Gaussian monthly-return Kalman filter, update completed month then propagate to forthcoming month
oracle.terminal: analytic Gaussian mean, variance, CRPS, loss probability and 10/90% quantiles from exact daily endpoint coefficients

primary.contrast: context-reference CRPS minus candidate CRPS; positive means improvement

question: How does the unchanged scalar readout respond to genuinely available information under specified complete-world laws?

randomness.generator: numpy PCG64 through SeedSequence([root_seed, world_id, stream_id, query_index, bank])
randomness.oracle_common_randomness: same bank standard normals across posterior information sets within query, separate banks and worlds; no collision with realized streams
randomness.paired_laws: same primitive state/noise draws across beta laws for each world ID; worlds independent

readout.entry: next daily close; exclude first post-query increment
readout.fit_and_calibration: same latest 24 strictly mature outcomes and features
readout.label_available: endpoint plus one day; strictly before query for training

reporting: all cells and each fixed arm, no selected winner
pooled and context references kept separate; old 17-family market atlas not transferred to artificial prices
exact terminal price-only minus current-signal oracle loss; decoder difference and oracle difference are different estimands; no fraction-recovered ratio
path-loss CRPS, event Brier, inclusive empirical80% interval coverage and width separately
world means first, across-world mean with pointwise95% percentile paired bootstrap CI, world median and10/90% quantiles
no multiple-testing declaration; pointwise intervals not simultaneous or a promotion rule
cell occupancy, fallbacks, effective atom count, outcome outside atom range
four-year unavailable cells stay explicit; no synthetic extension of query support
all failures/interrupted worlds retained with denominator and reason; no silent dropping
unit: Independent complete daily price histories. Arms share prices within world; no resampling forecast dates.
verification_before_scores: independent endpoint fixtures including entry exclusion
Kalman filter against direct Gaussian conditioning on small example
terminal coefficients/moments against independent covariance calculation
conditional simulations against terminal moments on separate engineering seed only
fixed caller parity and strict maturity/train-date inventory
future suffix mutations leave past features and issued distributions unchanged
frozen source hashes and full97date support; independent aggregation
